goal: Parsing a TaskRecord v4 rejects a history review_revision whose base_head differs from git_base_head, as it already does for attestations, and one end-to-end test proves a round-2 Review rework persists its revision and the round-3 Review snapshot receives prior_review_commit and delta_paths (#244; Spec docs/specs/review-revision-history-base.spec.md D1-D4). no user-visible change: internal parse invariant on Kernel-written state plus test coverage.

acceptance.assertion: In tests/kernel-record-v4.test.ts, parseTaskRecordV4 throws, naming record.history[<i>].review_revision.base_head, for a v4 record whose review-authored request_rework history entry carries review_revision.base_head different from git_base_head; the same entry with a matching base parses and keeps review_revision; a v4 history entry without review_revision parses; a v3 record carrying a review-authored history review_revision still parses (Spec D1, D2; BR-REQ-1, BR-REQ-2, BR-REQ-4).

In tests/host-neutral-assurance-coordinator.test.ts, over authorityFixture, a Review rework verdict applied through createVerdictAuthority at round 2 persists a review_round_2 request_rework history entry whose review_revision equals the round-2 snapshot revision; after staging an edit to exactly one in-scope path and returning to Review, buildAssuranceSnapshot yields review_delta with round 3, prior_review_commit equal to the round-2 review_commit, delta_paths equal to exactly that path (an unchanged path absent), and no skipped field (Spec D3; BR-REQ-3).

The existing write-time revision and manifest delta cases in tests/kernel-canary-rework-authority.test.ts, including rounds 1-2 digest stability, pass with unchanged assertions (Spec D2; BR-OUT-1, BR-OUT-2).
The generated Claude bundle matches its sources and .changeset/review-revision-history-base.md declares a patch release (Spec D4).
